title: DOSE-10060 stamp
description: The date a market's cards were last checked against the regulator. One signed stamp per full read of a market; every card of the market shows it. A stamp is a date, not a countdown: nothing expires. It is attached to a card when the card is served and is not inside the signed card. Version 1.3, 2026-11-18.

checked.description: The day of the last full read of the market.

covers.description: What the stamp covers: the market's cards as they stand at this point of the market's chain of changes.

kid.description: The record key, in the keyring.

sig.description: ES256 (raw r||s, base64url) over the JCS (RFC 8785) form of the stamp without sig.
